simple.meaning: שָׂנֵא (sânêʼ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to hate (personally).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 148 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 9 more, beginning at Genesis 24:60. Its contexts include family, family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׂנֵא (H8130).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שָׂנֵא (sânêʼ) / H8130 is traced through Genesis 24:60, Genesis 26:27, Genesis 29:31, Genesis 29:33 as a generated source-based concept entry.
